shortTitle: Issue preclusion within the assigned materials
summary: Issue preclusion prevents relitigation of a qualifying issue actually litigated and necessarily determined in an earlier action. It differs from a broader bar on relitigating the same claim.
notes: The full later preclusion chapter is outside the mapped syllabus.

sections.Meaning: Issue preclusion prevents relitigation of a qualifying issue actually litigated and necessarily determined in an earlier action. It differs from a broader bar on relitigating the same claim.
sections.How to work through the question: State the exact issue and its role in the earlier judgment. Cooper shows that the absence of a general discriminatory pattern may be binding even though individual claims have not been decided.
